figurative_meaning_en: The mannerisms or lifestyle of wealthy people
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে হঠাৎ ধনী হয়ে বড় চাল দেখাতে শুরু করেছে।
গ্রামের ছেলে শহরে গিয়ে বড় চাল চালছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He suddenly started putting on big airs after getting rich.
The village boy is acting like a big shot in the city.
note: Often used to describe ostentatious behavior mimicking the elite
